इमरान हाशमी के फैंस के लिए आई बेहद बड़ी खबर! 🎬

फिल्म Gunmaaster G9 को सेंसर बोर्ड यानी CBFC ने 'A' सर्टिफिकेट देकर पास कर दिया है, लेकिन मेकर्स को कई बदलाव करने पड़े हैं। ✂️

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक फिल्म में 3 जगहों से यौन उत्पीड़न वाले सीन हटाए गए हैं और 2 जगहों पर महिलाओं और नाबालिग बच्ची को नीचा दिखाने वाले डायलॉग बदले गए हैं।

इतना ही नहीं, फिल्म के दूसरे हाफ से 'polio' शब्द को हटाने और भारतीय नागरिक सम्मान के गलत संदर्भ को बदलने का भी आदेश दिया गया। 🚫

शुरुआत में शराब ब्रांड का नाम और अश्लील शब्द भी हटाए गए हैं। 25 नवंबर को सेंसर प्रमाणपत्र पाने वाली 2 घंटे 23 मिनट लंबी यह फिल्म 27 नवंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हो रही है। 🍿

क्या आप 'Aashiq Banaya Aapne' के बाद इमराान हाशमी, आदित्य दत्त और हिमेश रेशमिया की इस तिकड़ी को दोबारा देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
Earlier this year, Emraan Hashmi tasted huge success with Awarapan 2 . Naturally, there’s considerable excitement for his next release, Gunmaaster G9 , which arrives in cinemas this Friday. The censor process of the action musical thriller was completed on time, and Bollywood Hungama has exclusively learnt about the changes sought by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC).
Despite passing Gunmaaster G9 with an ‘A’ certificate, the CBFC’s Examining Committee asked the makers to carry out several modifications. To begin with, obscene words were replaced with suitably modified terms. The mention of a liquor brand in a dialogue at the beginning of the film was also replaced.
Moreover, an ‘inappropriate’ reference to an Indian civilian award was asked to be replaced in both the dialogue and the subtitles. The CBFC also asked the makers to remove the word ‘polio’ in the second half of the film.
Further, scenes involving the sexual assault of a minor girl and an adult woman were ordered to be deleted at three places in the film. Furthermore, dialogues belittling women and a minor girl were asked to be replaced at two places.
Once these changes were made, the censor certificate was handed to the makers of Gunmaaster G9 on November 25. The length of the film, as mentioned on the censor certificate, 143.00 minutes. In other words, Gunmaaster G9 is 2 hours and 23 minutes long.
Besides Emraan Hashmi, Gunmaaster G9 also stars Genelia Deshmukh, Aparshakti Khurana, Avneet Kaur and others. The film marks the reunion of Emraan Hashmi, director Aditya Datt and music composer Himesh Reshammiya, more than two decades after their hugely popular musical thriller Aashiq Banaya Aapne (2005).
Produced by Deepak Mukut, Hunar Mukut and Sangeeta Ahir, Gunmaaster G9 is all set to release in cinemas on November 27, 2026.
